Join a venture-backed software company building modern infrastructure for satellite operations. Its platform allows commercial and government customers to command, monitor and operate different spacecraft and constellations through one scalable software environment.

The company was founded by experienced engineers and satellite operators who wanted to replace fragmented, highly customized ground systems with modern, reusable software.

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer to develop scalable, cloud-based software supporting satellite operations. The ideal candidate has strong Python and AWS experience, with the ability to build reliable APIs, optimize cloud infrastructure, and contribute to backend architecture and automation. Previous aerospace experience is not required.

Candidates must have an active TS/SCI clearance, with the ability to maintain it throughout employment and work from the office under the required hybrid schedule.

Work directly with spacecraft systems, solve complex integration challenges, and help shape software used in real satellite missions.


Outstanding benefits include: unlimited PTO (minimum 15 days encouraged), 100% employee health insurance coverage, 4% 401(k) matching, quarterly wellness benefits, paid holidays, and equity.

Papaya is a leading skill-based mobile gaming company, bringing together fun, competition, and real rewards for millions of players worldwide.

Located in the heart of Tel Aviv, we offer a fast-moving environment, culture of innovation, professional growth, and the opportunity to make a true impact. We are looking for people who play for real and want to shape the future of gaming with us.

  • Demonstrated expertise in cloud environment, with substantial practical experience operating within major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • A relentless drive to evaluate and adopt cutting-edge technologies to solve complex engineering challenges.

  • Data-driven product work: A/B tests, working with BI, analytics in SQL (e.g. Snowflake).

Company Overview:

Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

About the Role

You are an engineer who, above all, is excited to build products that give our customers the best possible experience purchasing prescription medications. You have professional experience working on a team turning ideas into reliable, maintainable code — and ideally, you are eager to apply AI and machine learning to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and personalized.

We believe in using a small number of well-known tools like AWS, Python, Javascript, MySQL/Postgres, and Linux. We are looking for engineers that value simplicity, pragmatism, and a bias toward action, and who are passionate about building products that bring real value to our customers.

Sr Software Engineers at Blink are responsible for building our world-class products. Your job is to take ownership over one of our hardest problems, envision and refine strategic solutions, and drive execution like an entrepreneur.

You will collaborate closely with a talented, cross-functional team of designers, product managers, data scientists, marketers, and operators. Through these partnerships, you’ll grow our business, build our core platform, and—above all—make sure that our customers have access to the least expensive and highest satisfaction pharmacy experience on earth.

At Blink, we determine the specific focus of engineering roles through the interview process. Key potential areas of ownership include:

  • Our telemedicine platform
  • Our home delivery experience
  • Our growth team
  • Our core pharmacy platform
  • New product line development
  • AI-powered personalization, automation, and decision-support systems

How to Achieve Success / Acumen

All Blinkers are expected to operate with our value of “Good Giving” in mind. Our culture is infused with the dedication and enthusiasm of employees who continuously strive to make a difference. Here’s how you will do that in this role:

Good Execution — Do your best work

  • Design new APIs to power innovative features
  • Fix performance problems and debug production issues
  • Perform peer code and architecture reviews
  • Build new features, write unit tests, and lead the release of these features to production
  • Develop and A/B test new ReactJS components to improve our user experience
  • Design, build, deploy and use AI/ML solutions for telemedicine triage, prescription guidance, fraud detection, personalization, and operational automation

Good Owner — Be the CEO of your role

  • Help the team ship new products and features successfully with the right skills, mentorship, and organizational resources to deliver amazing experiences for our patients
  • Coach, mentor, and develop engineers to reach individual goals while fostering cross-functional collaboration and product success
  • Take responsibility for the long-term success of product projects and people
  • Champion responsible adoption of AI across engineering and product teams, ensuring solutions are ethical, reliable, and scalable

Good Learning — Learn something new every day

  • Demonstrate curiosity and an interest in learning new techniques and improving upon best practices to stay up-to-date with current and emerging trends
  • Lead by example: put new ideas into action, fail fast, and learn from each experience
  • Stay ahead of advances in AI/ML (including LLMs, NLP, recommendation systems, and predictive analytics) and apply them thoughtfully to our products

Good Feedback — Consider the perspective of others

  • Listen actively and respond effectively through a variety of channels
  • Give and receive candid and constructive feedback
  • Promote trust and encourage teamwork to allow the product team to do their best work

Desired Experience

  • 4+ years in a software engineering role
  • You want to work in a highly collaborative environment: we believe a team can be stronger than its individual parts
  • Independent and curious, comfortable owning features from design through delivery to production
  • Experience with one or more modern programming languages (Python, JavaScript, etc.)
  • Willingness to dive into a large code base and contribute immediately
  • Enjoy writing code that is understandable, maintainable, and testable
  • Collaborative and communicative — you love being part of a diverse team, building consensus, and establishing credibility. You are a Class-A communicator: curious, thoughtful, clear, and (mostly) correct.
  • BE/BTech degree from a top institution

AI-Preferred Skills

  • Experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., MCP servers, n8n, Google ADK, Vector DBs and Langchain)
  • Familiarity with LLMs, Fine tuning, and generative AI for personalization and patient support and order workflow
  • Experience integrating AI into production-grade systems with measurable business impact
  • Interest in applying AI responsibly in healthcare to maximize patient value and trust

Why Join Us:

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Workplace team’s mission is to create and support work environments that are welcoming, comfortable, and intuitive. These spaces are designed to promote collaboration, well-being, and productivity while adhering to the rigorous safety, security, and confidentiality standards required of a financial services company.

The Workplace Experience team comprises operations, hospitality-focused and financially responsible professionals who directly shape the daily experiences of Stripes, visitors, and candidates across 20+ global office locations. This geographically dispersed team oversees facilities management, daily operations, and programs, including a culinary team dedicated to preparing nutritious meals.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a strategic leader and experienced workplace manager with a high EQ who's enthusiastic about, and has a driving need to deliver, the best possible workplace experience for Stripes. You will be a key member of our Experience team and responsible for ensuring that workplace operations, experiences, facilities, and programs run smoothly at our Bengaluru office. As a business partner, you have a deep understanding of the needs, experiences, and day-to-day realities of Stripes at your location and build strong relationships not only with site leads but also with cross-functional partners across the organization.

This role requires a high level of expertise and operational oversight—from understanding how the building functions top to bottom to governance of contractor team performance and ensuring financial accountability. Bengaluru is a complex site with a significant employee transportation program, and you will be accountable for the reliability, service quality, and continuous improvement of these operations. You will work in close strategic partnership with our integrated facilities management partner, establishing clear expectations, maintaining strong governance, addressing performance gaps, and ensuring services meet Stripe’s operational and workplace experience standards.

You will also play a critical role in managing operational incidents and disruptions. This requires remaining calm under pressure, bringing structure to ambiguity, coordinating the appropriate internal and external partners, communicating clearly with stakeholders, and translating lessons from incidents into durable operational improvements.

A key part of the role is anticipating the needs of the business by understanding both the site and the broader context of company growth. You will gather and synthesize feedback from multiple sources to ensure the workplace strategy is informed by real insights from the ground. While enterprise workplace strategy is developed centrally, you are expected to bring informed recommendations based on local business needs and operational insight, and to own successful implementation and adoption at your site. Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

The Director of Product Science ensures the scientific credibility and rigor of Datavant Life Sciences’ real-world evidence and data discovery agents. The (Sr.) Director of Product Science works closely with product and engineering stakeholders and is accountable to ensure agent conceptualization, development, and evaluation meet the needs of Datavant’s internal and external scientific customers and the scientific standards of the Datavant science team. Specifically, the (Sr.) Director works across and within product zones (e.g. evidence generation, data discovery) and product pods (e.g. algorithm builder, explore assistant) on the following:

  • Scientific agent conceptualization (e.g. why is the agent needed? and for whom?)
  • Scientific problem statement
  • Agent task and bounds
  • Scientific workflow design & SME review/decision points
  • Scientific reference set and agent context
  • Scientific evaluation design and application
  • Scientific internal testing requirements and execution

The scope of this role includes application of domain knowledge and RWE expertise in the development of agents and agent systems intended to complete scientific tasks. As the senior scientific leader working within the product pods and zones, the Director is accountable for scientific submissions for product/roadmap governance review, including eval sets, agent performance metrics, etc. The role also serves as the SME on the non-agentic scientific workflows relevant to the agent/agent system.

In addition to working within the product pods, the Director serves as the science lead for customer delivery of agent co-build/co-development/co-design scientific partnerships with Datavant’s pharma and data ecosystem customers. In this role, the Director is responsible and accountable for the scientific quality of the contracted and delivered scientific work, which may include the design of customer-specific agentic RWE workflows, application of those workflows to customer SOPs, design and development of customer-specific agents for RWE tasks across the workflow, and evaluation of those agents.

The Director contributes to agentic AI scientific thought leadership activities at the discretion of the Head of Product Science and the Chief Science Officer (CSO). This may include contributions to blogs, webinars, and/or live presentations at scientific meetings.

The Director contributes to scientific support of GTM teams on translating customer and competitor intelligence and identifying market signals.

What You Need to Succeed

  • Doctorate or master’s degree in epidemiology, biostatistics, or a related field
  • Professional research experience in real-world evidence (RWE), pharmacoepidemiology, health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), or a closely related field: at least 3 years after a doctorate or 6 years after a master’s degree for Director; at least 5 years after a doctorate or 8 years after a master’s degree for Senior Director
  • Strong command of observational study design, healthcare data, and analytic methods, with the ability to assess methodological choices and interpret findings in light of study limitations.

  • Experience managing or providing matrix leadership to colleagues, including coaching and substantive feedback: at least 1 year for Director or 2 years for Senior Director.

data.description:
Ledgebrook is an AI-native specialty insurance platform. When a business needs coverage that is custom and complex, its broker comes to us, and our underwriters give them an answer, often in hours rather than weeks.

We built our technology from scratch, with AI in it from the first line of code. The technology helps price the risk; the underwriter uses their judgment to decide. There are always two hands on the wheel.

We are insurance industry insiders, and we eat our own cooking: Ledgebrook writes the policy and shares the risk through our own carrier, Ledgebrook Specialty, rated A- (Excellent) by AM Best. We work exclusively through wholesale brokers.

Our vision: to make the wheels of insurance spin faster.

At Ledgebrook, everything we do is driven by our culture: Care, Strive, Thrive Together. To succeed in modernizing the industry, we must first succeed in changing the way we do business. Talent density is our north star—fewer, better people working together as one. To that end we’ve replaced all individual incentives with generous equity packages—we play as a team, we win as a team. Everyone benefits handsomely from Ledgebrook’s success.


About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Full Stack Software Engineer to help us solve the complex, technical challenges of a changing insurance landscape. The ideal candidate loves to build, communicates well with team members , and is motivated by a less bureaucracy. This person will be a key member of our engineering team, with direct ownership of many parts of the stack.

What you’ll do

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to develop new features and enhance existing applications.
  • Design and implement frontend and backend components using JavaScript (Node.js) and Python.
  • Develop RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party services as needed.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards.
  • Implement automated tests and ensure high code quality through code reviews and continuous integration.
  • Optimize application performance and scalability to handle growing user demands.
  • Dive into using and building LLMs (Large Language Models) to enhance our underwriters' productivity.
  • Debug production issues using the latest tooling.
  • Help set the direction of the small but growing engineering team.


About you

Here at Ledgebrook we are passionate about creating a team that is on a continuous learning journey and that shares our excitement about building a company from the ground up. Some of the characteristics we hold dear are:

  • A passion to deliver a world-class customer service experience to both internal and external customers
  • Intellectual curiosity and a desire to innovate processes/procedures versus being satisfied with the status quo
  • A desire to continue learning whatever your career stage
  • Agile prioritization skills coupled with a keen sense of urgency that seeks to balance getting it right versus getting it done right now
  • A strong drive and desire to win together as a high-performing team
  • A moral compass to “do the right thing, period”, we have zero tolerance for toxic behaviors.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience with the full stack development

  • Strong ability to design data models based on business domain use cases
  • Proven ability to write code for the future, with a strong focus on maintainability and testability

Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. About the Role

Our Marketing team brings together marketing operations, engineering, data, and AI to make complex go-to-market work easier to manage. We create reliable systems that help marketers work more effectively, move with greater speed, and deliver measurable business results.

As a Senior Marketing Operations Manager, you will lead the campaign operations foundation that supports demand generation while helping shape how AI changes the way our Marketing team works. You will use automation, agents, connected data, and accessible technical solutions to reduce repetitive work, improve execution, and create new capabilities across Marketing.

This is a collaborative, hands-on role for someone who enjoys supporting critical marketing systems, working through evolving business needs, and developing practical solutions. Success will be measured by faster execution, improved pipeline outcomes, higher-quality data, and sustained adoption of the systems you help create.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our HQ in San Mateo, CA five days a week.

About Turing

Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at .

Software Engineer

We build the infrastructure that frontier AI labs use to evaluate coding agents and language models: benchmark datasets, agent evaluation runs at scale, and automated task quality checks. You would own features across the stack, from the data model and background jobs to the screens our users work in every day.

This is a role for an experienced engineer who works independently, makes sound tradeoffs, and turns a loosely defined request into something shipped, tested, and safe to leave alone.

What you will do

  • Design and ship features end to end: data model, API, background workers, and the UI when the change needs it.
  • Build and improve how agents and models are evaluated: running trials in sandboxed environments, scoring results, and turning thousands of runs into results people can trust.
  • Improve how benchmark tasks are quality-checked: verifiers, rubric-based and LLM-as-a-judge grading, and deciding whether a task is clear, solvable, and fair to score.
  • Integrate new models, agents, and benchmarks in a way that generalizes, without a special case for each one.
  • Keep the system fast and reliable as usage grows: efficient queries, safe migrations, and concurrency that holds up under load.
  • Review teammates’ pull requests against our engineering guidelines and help keep the codebase consistent.

What you bring

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with ownership of at least one service from design through on-call.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Strong Python and experience with Django (or a similar framework), PostgreSQL, and a task queue such as Celery. What matters most is having run a real system, not knowing a particular framework.
  • Hands-on experience in LLM evaluation, beyond calling a model API. You understand how a benchmark task is built, how an agent trial is scored, and how results are aggregated and compared. Experience with Harbor, Terminal-Bench, SWE-bench, Inspect, or a similar harness is a strong plus.
  • Judgment about task quality. You can spot ambiguous instructions, weak or gameable verifiers, leaked answers, and checks that pass for the wrong reason.
  • Good tradeoffs. You reach for the smallest design that solves the problem, extend what already exists before adding something new, and can explain what you chose not to build.
  • Ownership. You take a fuzzy request, find the relevant code, ask questions only when the answer changes the design, and finish the job, including migrations, tests, and edge cases users will hit.
  • Quick adoption of team conventions. You read the written guidelines and your first pull requests already match them in naming, structure, tests, and error handling.
  • Comfort with a TypeScript and React frontend when a change is visible there. You don’t need to be a frontend specialist.
  • Clear writing. Your pull request descriptions and design notes explain why, not just what.

Nice to have

  • Experience running agents in sandboxed or containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud sandboxes such as Modal or Daytona).
  • Experience with LLM-as-a-judge or rubric-based grading, and with reducing judge bias and noise.
  • Familiarity with coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or OpenHands, and with MCP.
  • Experience with distributed job scheduling, concurrency limits, or database locking at scale.
  • Contributions to open-source evaluation or infrastructure projects.

How we work

  • Written engineering guidelines, applied consistently, with the same review bar for everyone.
  • Business logic lives in services. Hot paths stay cheap. Lint and tests pass before a pull request is ready.
  • The same vocabulary in the code, the API, and the UI.
  • We prefer deleting code to adding it, and simple designs to clever ones.

A strong first month looks like several changes merged with light review, and one area of the system you can change confidently without a guide.

Values

  • We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.

  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection

  • We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

  • Work at the frontier of AI, helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.

  • Contribute to leading-edge AI research and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.

  • Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.

About xPay
xPay is a Y Combinator-backed international payments company building an international payment gateway focused on cross-border payments making it dramatically easier for businesses to move money across borders. Our customers are B2B SaaS companies that need fast, reliable and cost-effective payment infrastructure to serve global users.
These businesses are increasingly moving their international volumes from billion-dollar companies to xPay as we expand our footprint across 180+ countries and support 25+ currencies. Since January 2025, we have grown 73 and now process over 1 million transactions every month.
Cross-border payments is a trillion market. Our top customers include publicly listed, Series D and Series E companies across sectors such as EdTech and travel, processing millions through us every month.


About the Role
We re looking for a Backend Engineer to build the services powering xPay s global payments infrastructure. You ll own features end to end, from design and development to production deployment and on-call support, working closely with product, engineering, and the founders.


What You ll Do
  • Design, build, and ship production-grade backend services and APIs using Java 21, Spring Boot, and MongoDB, working with Redis, ClickHouse, and AWS services including ECS, SQS, S3, and SES.
  • Build and scale multi-currency payment systems that support complex global payment flows.
  • Own features throughout their lifecycle, from requirements and technical design to deployment, monitoring, and on-call support.
  • Work closely with product and engineering to turn ideas into reliable features quickly.
  • Design MongoDB data models, indexes, and update patterns that balance performance, consistency, and scalability.
  • Improve reliability and performance across services, databases, and APIs.
  • Debug production issues, identify bottlenecks, and drive lasting improvements to architecture and operations.


What We re Looking For
  • 4 6 years of backend engineering experience, preferably at an early-stage startup or in a small team with end-to-end ownership.
  • Strong production experience with Java, Spring Boot, and MongoDB. Hands-on experience with all three is mandatory.
  • Solid MongoDB data modelling skills, including indexing, transactions versus atomic updates, and versioning.
  • Strong fundamentals in API design, system design, and distributed systems.
  • Experience building, scaling, and maintaining production-grade backend systems.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with a focus on reliability and performance.
  • Clear communication, a high degree of ownership, and the ability to move quickly in a high-growth environment.


Why Join xPay
  • Global payments infrastructure: Solve complex problems across countries, currencies, and payment flows.
  • Direct access to founders: Help shape product decisions, engineering practices, and architecture.
  • Meaningful equity: Join an early team and share in the value you help create.
  • High ownership and impact: Build critical systems that directly affect xPay and its merchants.
